claim_ceiling: A governance audit. It licenses no claim of any kind.
directionality_precedent: changing the IMPLEMENTATION to match the REGISTERED TEXT is a bug fix; changing the REGISTERED TEXT to match the DATA is p-hacking. The difference is the direction, not the outcome

divergences.registered_text: the estimand is REPLACED with a logit-difference recovery ratio
divergences.source_excerpt:
def estimand_logit_difference_recovery(l_clean: float, l_patch: float,
                                       l_full: float) -> float:
    """The estimand the directive prescribes.

        effect = (L_patch - L_clean) / (L_full - L_clean)

    where each L is a logit DIFFERENCE, donor answer minus recipient answer,
    taken in the run named by the subscript.
    """
    return (l_patch - l_clean) / (l_full - l_clean)
divergences.what_the_code_actually_does: P-0 computed (gap - ld_recipient) / (ld_donor - ld_recipient), where gap, ld_recipient and ld_donor are the logit differences in the patched, clean-recipient and clean-donor runs; the prescribed formula is the same expression under different names
divergences.why_this_entry_exists: an audit that only compared each tool to its own registration could not have noticed that a prescribed replacement was not one

entries.what_the_code_actually_does: no measurement tool in this namespace applies an effect estimand; verify_baseline computes only no-op deviations, whose numerator is exactly zero under any recovery ratio of this shape

entries.registered_text: a non-vacuity demonstration must include a case that MUST RETURN POSITIVE
entries.what_the_code_actually_does: the demonstration iterates REQUIRED and fails unless every case's verdict equals its requirement; two of the four requirements are positive-valued

entries.registered_text: four cases: no-op, random vector, full donor, carries the intermediate
entries.what_the_code_actually_does: the four keys are exactly these, in this order

entries.registered_text: the four cases run on synthetic or constructed objects and may not take a threshold from P-0's existing data
entries.what_the_code_actually_does: the synthetic world is built from a registered seed and fixed constants; no P-0 artifact is opened by the module

entries.implementation: count_inclusion reads the value from the pushed registration

entries.registered_text: the directive requires disclosing whether the pair count was known when the floor was set
entries.what_the_code_actually_does: the registration records that only the two separate marginals were known, that the joint count had never been computed, and that it was deliberately left uncomputed until the registration was pushed

entries.implementation: count_inclusion reads the value from the pushed registration

entries.registered_text: the no-op families must be within 1e-4, on the normalised scale
entries.what_the_code_actually_does: the verdict is taken on worst_abs_mean_normalised; raw logits are reported beside it but do not decide
